notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 9 or greater.
description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {2}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
